s.nota: A long walk in the woods and the hills between Lake Maggiore and Mergozzo on the historic Roman road that led to the Ossola and the Simplon Pass
Between ancient summer pastures and centuries-old chestnut to explore the southern part of the National Park to reach the last inhabited permanently pasture of the Val Grande

s.n: P00 - Madonna di Campagna - Santino - Rovegro- Cossogno- Cicogna - Pogallo
A00g - Fondotoce scalinata cimitero vecchio - bivio A00e
s.nota: From Fondotoce along the steep staircase of the old cemetery and then on the track and then the path You reach the paved mule-track that goes up to Cavandone

The mountaineers came in the lower Valgrande along two lines that from Rovegro to Or Vergugn were common then one continued for Velina, Futt Bridge, Orfalecchio to Rodugno, ours for Scellina as far as Corte Buè, besides it was dangerous

A daring and challenging route that runs along the steep side of the Rio Valgrande with frequent dripping tunnels where an open-air water conduit flows, dilapidated small bridge and a Tibetan Bridge are the final highlight.

A short itinerary from Rovegro to the Chapel of Erfo which connects two paths of great interest: the P00 that from Verbania allows access to the Valgrande / ValPogallo and the A54 that from Mergozzo climbs the summit of Monte Faiè
A comfortable well-trained and well-kept mule tracker in the lower Val Grande. Almost flat the first part, then a steep but short climb up to Nolezzo

The Filo di Nolezzo is worthy of its name: a perfect ridge line, aerial from beginning to end, extremely panoramic and never really difficult, even if there are some very exposed and treacherous sections, especially in autumn for the leaves

s.n: P03 - Oratorio di Santino - bivio A54 nei pressi Cappella di Erfo
s.a: Bivio A54 sotto Cappella di Erfo
s.nota: Short path that reaches the Cappella di Erfo keeping in the woods below the road

Initially you travel along roads and dirt roads till Romanico then you enter broad-leaved woods up to the destination with a route mainly on paths and forest tracks. A ford at the Selva Spessa stream can pose problems in case of rain
Short route that takes place mainly on the road except for the final stretch on dirt and a short path also suitable for tourists. Interesting visit to the medieval "torraccia" of Feriolo

s.n: VM3b - Bivio VM3 - Croce Monte Camoscio
s.a: Ferrata dei Picasass Croce Monte Camoscio

s.n: Grand Tour del Lago Maggiore ® - Tappa 1 - Verbania Intra - Stresa
s.nota: An 11-stage trek that brings together and connects ancient historical routes, paths and pre-existing trails on the shores and hills surrounding Lake Maggiore, designed by CAI Sezione Verbano Intra. Descriptions are available on the Website.
